observations: Rectangular black tempered glass center table.
White floral and vine etching on the surface.
Visible chips and cracks on the right side of the glass.
The glass is resting on a concrete floor against a rough wall.
The glass appears to be a single piece with no visible frame or legs.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The glass is cracked or has hidden chips not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the glass being tapped to reveal cracks.

risks.risk: The table is not tempered glass (could be float glass).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the glass edge or a manufacturer's label.

risks.risk: The table is missing its legs.
risks.proof: A photo of the table with all four legs attached.

proof_requests: Photo of the table with all four legs attached.
Close-up photo of the glass edge to check for heat marks or cracks.
Video of the glass being tapped to confirm it is not cracked.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a black tempered glass center table. While the glass shows visible damage, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a damaged tabletop.
